🚧 Traffic Advisory 🚧

There will be a temporary closure of Kigobe Road in Nakawa Division at the Valley section starting on 9th January 2026 for a period of two (2) months to allow for Box culvert construction.

Alternative routes to use;
1. Traffic from Ntinda will use Canon Road to Kiwatule Road.
2. Traffic from East African Road will use Kaduyu Road and Ssebowa Road to connect to Kiwatule Road.

We regret any inconvenience that this may cause. 

MANAGEMENT

data.text:
Much has been said about the lower box-office performance of the ongoing Metro Manila Film Festival. #MMFF51 #MMFF2025 

At this point, any claims about box office performance are merely hearsay, as the MMFF and the producers/exhibitors have agreed not to disclose box office numbers until the festival concludes, demonstrating solidarity for all entries. 

Quality can't also be called out, as at least five of this year's entries have all enjoyed a decent/great amount of appreciation from critics and audiences alike-- Bar Boys: After School, Call Me Mother, I'mPerfect, Manila's Finest, and Unmarry.

But as they say, when there's smoke, there's fire.

I do think it's obvious what the two factors are that changed within the last two years since they last hit the billion-peso mark. 

(1/4)
